sheets.title: Search in the prompt — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: A vault of 14 logins, searched for "git". Search is the prompt's own `/?` verb: the list narrows in place and the status row counts it, instead of a second field opening above the prompt.
sheets.before: 2 text inputs on screen (search field 352x44 above the prompt 248x44); list 2 of 14 after typing in the second one
sheets.after: 1 text input on screen (the prompt, 248x44); `/? git` narrows the list to 2 rows, status reads 2/14 · /git

sheets.title: The list, its header and the Add button — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The same 14-item list at rest. Add is one button in the corner; the header names the view and carries a way back and the filter.

sheets.after: header is back 44x44 + the view's name 331x48 ("All items"); one Add button 100x56 in the corner: + 56x56 with an attached ellipsis 44x56

sheets.title: The section tree — 390 × 844

sheets.before: a 390x52 search key row across the top and a separate 60x60 Add key

sheets.title: Add's alternatives — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: A long press on the + (the ellipsis next to it is the same ask) opens one `Add actions` menu as the app's own context sheet. Tapping + goes straight to a new item.

sheets.after: long press opens "Add actions": 2 entries (Import items, Export items), each 374x44; New item is the + itself
